results.text: Safety assessment of esomeprazole: real-world adverse event signal mining and analysis based on FAERS database. Esomeprazole holds a significant position in the treatment of acid-related diseases. However, as with all drugs, it may also carry some potential risk of adverse effects. This study aims to further evaluate the safety of esomeprazole for clinical use.
